info.name: Paxos Account Members Crypto Withdrawals API

items.docs: Updates a specified crypto destination address. If the address does not exist, it will be created

params.name: ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the UUIDs of the crypto destination addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: identity_ids
params.description: Optionally filter by the Identities the destination addresses are scoped to. Limit 100.

params.name: crypto_networks
params.description: Optionally filter by the `crypto_network` of the destination addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Optionally filter by specific addresses. Limit 100.

params.name: nicknames
params.description: Optionally filter by specific nicknames. Limit 100.

params.name: bookmarked_status
params.description: Optionally filter by bookmarked status. If omitted, addresses regardless of bookmarked status will be returned.

params.name: created_at.lt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly less than lt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.lte
params.description: Include timestamps less than or equal to lte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.eq
params.description: Include timestamps exactly equal to eq. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gte
params.description: Include timestamps greater than or equal to gte. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: created_at.gt
params.description: Include timestamps strictly greater than gt. RFC3339 format, like `2006-01-02T15:04:05Z`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 100 if no limit is provided. Maximum 1000.

params.name: order
params.description: Return items in ascending (ASC) or descending (DESC) order. Defaults to DESC.

params.name: order_by
params.description: The specific method by which the returned results will be ordered.

params.name: page_cursor
params.description: Optional cursor for getting the next page of results.

items.docs: List all crypto destination addresses, optionally filtering and paging the results

Withdraw a cryptocurrency asset to a specified destination address.

**Important for Stellar Network (PYUSD):**

When withdrawing PYUSD on the Stellar network, the destination address must have an established trustline with the PYUSD issuer:

- **PYUSD Issuer**: `GDQE7IXJ4HUHV6RQHIUPRJSEZE4DRS5WY577O2FY6YQ5LVWZ7JZTU2V5` (mainnet)
- **Asset Code**: `PYUSD`
